verdict.comment: Mashaan isn't opposed lightly but Lion's Dream and the veteran SAVALAS are plausible alternatives.

comments.balmybreese: Longstanding maiden but his best runs for this yard have come over C&D; fast pace a plus
comments.banana: 44-race maiden; effective over C&D but needs to rebound from a poor run 12 days ago
comments.globaleffort: Three course wins in the last 9 months; ran okay over 5f here latest; widest stall to defy
comments.himawari: Inconsistent maiden; this is her level but others look more appealing for the win
comments.lionsdream: Ended losing run of 22 when asserting late in a similar race here 12 days ago; respected
comments.mashaan: Course winner; easy 7f success at Lingfield on Monday; 0-15 at 6f but still a key player
comments.nordicglory: C&D win this month before a lesser effort behind Lion's Dream latest; can rebound
comments.poshmaisie: Limited encouragement for current stable and she looks vulnerable once more
comments.redwalls: C&D win in January; in and out since and likely to have other pace to deal with today
comments.savalas: C&D win last November; patchy since but may find this being run to suit his hold-up style
comments.werereunited: Collared late over C&D last November; had an excuse latest; other pace on show here

races.raceComment: nordicglory is confidently preferred with a score of 57.0%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and more progressive over mashaan. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for PESSOA, who got back on the scorsesheet with a strong-finishing win over 7f here last week.

comments.absolutelynot: In good hands and still early days but she needs a transformation on handicap debut
comments.annaleelass: Not easy to predict but she won over C&D on penultimate run; not ruled out
comments.bluejayway: 16-race maiden who still has stamina to prove at this trip; best watched on return
comments.haafadiamond: Out of sorts last year and needs a major revival after six months off
comments.lhebayeb: Fair fourth over C&D latest but he's 0-22 on AW and last turf win was in 2023
comments.pessoa: Five-time course winner, most recently last week; respected back up in trip under penalty
comments.portnoir: Six of ten wins have been at this track and she's on a workable mark; in the mix
comments.possibleambition: Lightly raced in last 12 months and has struggled in last three runs; lots to prove
comments.scarfo: Held in sixth here in last two runs and he's now 1-16; others look stronger
comments.voltaic: On workable mark but he's not easy to predict and was quiet here last week

races.raceComment: portnoir is marginally preferred with a score of 52.7%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over pessoa. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The most appealing option is MERRIMACK who has twice finished runner-up here and had excuses at Lingfield on his latest start.

comments.alafdhal: Has won here four times; most recently runner-up in Wolverhampton Class 6
comments.angleland: On 12-race losing run but met some trouble at Southwell latest and has won over C&D
comments.birkenhead: Encouragement at Southwell on second run after a break; handily weighted
comments.darksideprince: Five C&D wins including this race last year; needs to rediscover some form
comments.diamonddreamer: Five AW wins elsewhere; his level dipped at Wolverhampton latest but that was 6f
comments.generalassembly: Made all, just holding on, in similar race at Wolverhampton latest; cheekpieces added
comments.leodisdream: Has won over C&D; poor run at Newcastle two back but showed up well at Southwell latest
comments.merrimack: Twice runner-up in similar races here over the winter; can be excused below-par run latest
comments.secrethandsheikh: Ten-time winner elsewhere but unproven around this track and has been off since October

races.raceComment: darksideprince is marginally preferred with a score of 55.8%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over alafdhal. verdict.comment: Three-time course winner ONCE ADAAY returned from a layoff with a good run here in January and remains well handicapped.

comments.flagcarrier: Has modest strike-rate but was unlucky not to finish closer to the target on latest outing
comments.francisco: Started slowly in all three handicaps but was placed over 6f the last twice
comments.gotnodollars: 1m course winner in January; still on workable mark but this drop back to 7f is not ideal
comments.justrita: Ran well on second of two stable starts but is 0-15 overall; not the percentage call
comments.kondratievwave: Didn't fire last time but this largely consistent 8yo was in good form beforehand
comments.kracking: Free-goer who has not been getting home in his recent races; drops back in trip today
comments.onceadaay: Triple course winner; ran well here in January, after a break, and remains well treated
comments.stellahogan: Has her quirks but won over C&D three weeks ago and has run well over 1m since
comments.thomasequinas: Needs to better his recent efforts but was a C&D winner off 1lb higher in October

races.raceComment: onceadaay is marginally preferred with a score of 57.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over kondratievwave. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
